QuestInfo.name: Strange World: Verne Mine
QuestInfo.0: Someone calling themselves the Great Puppeteer sent you a weird letter. It's probably a prank, but it can't hurt to check it out.
QuestInfo.2: Angelic Buster found you at the Mine Entrance and gave you Kaiser's report.
QuestInfo.1: It might be worth meeting this Francis person if they have some kind of useful information.
